# Part 08 · Remote MCP Architecture

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DceKwrFRm6a/) · Published 25 Aug 2026

> What does a 37-line MCP server need before it can run in production?

measure.sh's MCP layer is 37 lines of Go. Its session-bound OAuth is 827 lines and its tool catalogue is over 2,000.

## The idea

- The protocol is JSON-RPC, and an SDK already solves it.
- Remote MCP needs auth: OAuth 2.1 with short, self-revoking sessions.
- Nested agent tools need recursion guards. Text-to-SQL needs schema pruning, a read-only parse, a forced tenant id and a read replica.

- `script.md`: the full breakdown, and what was said on camera
